# Riddhi Siddhi Fabricator

> Precision Architectural Fabrication of Aluminium, uPVC, and Stainless Steel in Muzaffarpur, Bihar.

## Business Identity & NAP
- **Business Name**: Riddhi Siddhi Fabricator

## Core Materials & Fabrication Capabilities

### 1. Aluminium Fabrication
- Custom 2-track and 3-track sliding windows with integrated insect/mosquito mesh.
- Aluminium casement windows and heavy-duty entrance doors.
- Glass office cabin partition systems.
- Commercial shopfronts and structural glazing curtain wall facades.
- Anodized and powder-coated architectural frame finishes.

### 2. uPVC Windows & Doors
- Energy-efficient multi-chamber uPVC sliding and casement windows.
- Acoustic noise reduction and thermal insulation window systems.
- Moisture-proof and waterproof uPVC bathroom doors.
- Weather-sealed sliding patio glass doors.

### 3. Stainless Steel & Metal Fabrication
- Heavy-duty Jindal 304 grade stainless steel main entrance gates with precision TIG welding.
- Custom CNC laser-cut decorative gates and architectural safety grill panels.
- Balcony safety railings and staircase handrails with crystal acrylic pillars.
- Frameless toughened glass railing systems.

## Service Area
- **Epicenter**: Muzaffarpur, Bihar
- **Regional Coverage**: Vaishali, Hajipur, Samastipur, Darbhanga, Sitamarhi, Motihari, Saran, Patna, and North Bihar.
